entities.name: RsmA/KsgA methyltransferase
observations: 297 aa bacterial protein; exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q03HF6 from Pediococcus pentosaceus.
Curated function: dimethylates adjacent 16S rRNA adenosines A1518 and A1519 in the 30S subunit; cytoplasmic enzyme.
Assigned EC 2.1.1.182 and Pfam RrnaAD (PF00398.27; residues 23–266).

entities.name: 16S rRNA A1518/A1519 dimethylation
observations: Two adjacent adenosines in 16S rRNA are converted to N6-dimethyladenosines using four S-adenosyl-L-methionine molecules, producing four S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine molecules and four protons.
Mapped to Rhea RHEA:19609, with component mappings RHEA:10232 and RHEA:10233; EC 2.1.1.182.

entities.name: S-adenosyl-L-methionine
observations: Methyl-group donor used four times in the annotated overall reaction.

entities.name: S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine
observations: Product formed four times in the annotated overall reaction.

entities.name: 30S ribosomal subunit biogenesis
observations: The enzyme's rRNA dimethylation may contribute to bacterial 30S subunit biogenesis.
